p8_b4.ocr: The identification and annotation of these genes provide valuable insights for future research directions, particularly in understanding how these genetic factors contribute to the clinical manifestation of movement disorders. By focusing on the functional roles of these genes, researchers can better elucidate their contributions to disease mechanisms, potentially paving the way for novel interventions aimed at mitigating the impact of movement disorders on affected individuals.
